propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria from multiple seams (packaged overlay, detector registries, project LLM/DET policies), allowing a project disable to be ignored, an activated project DET criterion to disappear, or separate reads to reflect different repository policy states.

CriteriaSnapshot must compile one immutable, digest-bound authority containing effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, routing metadata, and source provenance from the repository root and resolved operation inputs before any selection or model invocation.

Code-review project LLM criteria must require a non-empty applies_to list of repository-relative globs; applies_to=["**"] selects the criterion unconditionally (including when changed_files is empty), preserving the prior ungated behavior of an empty list.

Project code-review LLM criteria with missing, empty, non-list, or blank applies_to must fail with the criterion id, configuration location, and remediation message "use [\"**\"] for repository-wide".

The shared _validate_applies_to validator must remain unchanged to preserve plan-review project criteria (which carry no applies_to) and other gates; the stricter code-review-only rule is applied only at snapshot-compile time in the CriteriaSnapshot path.
CriteriaSnapshot digest reuses and extends the existing _overlay_signature content digest rather than inventing a parallel digest mechanism.
